title: China Blocks Meta, Hands AI Startup Manus to Tencent
description:
China basically just yanked an AI agent out of Meta's hands and gave it to a local champion 🔥

Manus is the startup here, an AI agent doing around $500M a year, run out of Singapore. Back in april Beijing blocked Meta from buying it and called the deal a threat to the country tech backbone, then banned foreign money from touching it. Now Tencent is in talks for a controlling stake at that same $2B valuation.

The interesting bit, Tencent wants to bake Manus right into WeChat 😅 basicaly turning the super app into a full AI platform. Feels like they building a wall around thier AI startups, outsiders out, insiders welcome ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
